description: agentView lets ChatGPT update any browser-capable screen (a TV, tablet, kiosk, or signage panel) by talking. Ask ChatGPT to put a daily lunch menu on your bistro display, a sales dashboard on the office wall, or a waiting-room board on your practice screen, and the layout appears live within seconds. You manage screens, templates, and team members on agentview.de; ChatGPT drives them through the agentView connector.
